jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer (Agentic AI & Full Stack) - Vice President
jobs.description:
Citi is looking for a Lead Software Engineer to architect and deliver next-generation Agentic AI applications at the intersection of full-stack engineering and large language model integration. In this senior role, you will define the technical direction for AI-powered platforms, lead teams of engineers, and build production-grade systems that power autonomous, multi-agent workflows across Citi's global technology organization. This is a rare opportunity to shape how Agentic AI is designed, deployed, and governed at enterprise scale within one of the world's largest financial institutions.

Responsibilities

Architect secure, resilient, and high-performance full-stack applications designed to support complex Agentic AI workflows at enterprise scale.
Lead hands-on development across the full application stack — from React and TypeScript frontends to Python and Java microservices and RESTful/gRPC APIs — ensuring code is clean, modular, and production-ready.
Design and implement stateful, multi-turn, and multi-agent AI workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or Semantic Kernel.
Integrate applications with Citi's secure LLM gateway to access and manage AI models from Azure, Vertex, and other providers, including token usage, rate limits, and billing analytics.
Establish and enforce technical standards, design patterns, and engineering best practices for full-stack development and AI agent integration across teams.
Architect data models and integrate with relational and vector databases to enable stateful AI operations across complex, data-intensive workflows.
Lead and develop multiple engineering teams, owning performance evaluations, hiring decisions, and the technical growth of team members.
Evaluate emerging AI frameworks and tooling to evolve the technical stack and maintain a competitive engineering capability.

Required Qualifications & Skills

6 or more years of software engineering experience, with demonstrated ownership of technical delivery and team leadership across complex, large-scale programs.
Deep expertise in frontend development using React, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3, with a focus on building responsive, accessible, and production-grade user interfaces.
Advanced proficiency in Python (FastAPI, Flask, Celery) and/or Java (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud) for building scalable backend services and APIs.
Proven ability to design and build Agentic AI and LLM-integrated systems, with applied knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector embeddings, and semantic search.
Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift, Docker, and CI/CD platforms such as Harness, Jenkins, or Tekton for cloud-native deployments.
Solid command of enterprise security principles, including OAuth2, OIDC, TLS, and secrets management using tools such as HashiCorp Vault.
Experience designing and querying both relational databases (PostgreSQL, Oracle) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Couchbase) within production environments.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Beneficial Skills & Qualifications

Experience deploying and managing agents on enterprise Agentic AI runtime platforms, with familiarity around network policy compliance, egress controls, and resource governance.
Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) for mediating agent interactions with downstream business systems and databases.
Experience with NoSQL and vector database technologies such as Milvus or Pinecone in support of AI-native data architectures.
Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.

What We Offer

Joining Citi means working on technology that operates at global scale, with the scope and resources to make a genuine impact. As a Lead Software Engineer at this level, you will have real ownership over technical direction, access to cutting-edge AI infrastructure, and the opportunity to shape how enterprise-grade Agentic AI evolves within one of the world's most complex financial organizations.

A hybrid working model with 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely, giving you the structure of collaboration alongside meaningful flexibility.
Strategic ownership over high-impact engineering decisions that influence how AI systems are built and deployed across Citi globally.
Exposure to advanced AI and LLM infrastructure at a scale few organizations can offer, keeping your technical capabilities at the forefront of the industry.
Continuous learning and development opportunities, including access to emerging tools, frameworks, and engineering practices as they evolve.
A performance-driven environment where your contributions to delivery, architecture, and team development are recognized and rewarded.
Competitive financial wellbeing support, including compensation and benefits designed to reflect the seniority and scope of this role.
The ability to lead, mentor, and grow engineering teams, building lasting capability and technical culture within a global organization.

Apply now to lead the engineering of Agentic AI systems that will define how one of the world's largest financial institutions builds, deploys, and scales intelligent technology.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Digital Experience Platforms
jobs.description:
The Klick Group
—comprising Klick Health (including Klick Katalyst and btwelve), Klick Media Group, Klick Applied Sciences (including Klick Labs), Klick Consulting, and Klick Ventures—is an ecosystem dedicated to realizing the full potential of our people and clients in life sciences. Founded in 1997, we have offices in New York, Philadelphia, Saratoga Springs, Toronto, London, São Paulo, and Singapore. Consistently named a Best Managed Company, Most Admired Corporate Culture, and Great Place to Work, Klick is committed to fostering a high-performance, people-first culture with creativity, collaboration, innovation, and impact across everything we do.

About Our Technology Craft

Our Technology Craft powers Klick’s innovation through platforms, products, and emerging technologies. This craft enables scale, efficiency, and experimentation across the business. Technology teams transform ideas into functional, future-ready solutions. Their work supports both client delivery and internal growth.

Job Description

The Senior Director, Digital Experience Platforms is a senior technical leader responsible for the delivery, quality, and strategic direction of digital experience and platform solutions across a portfolio of client engagements. The role serves as a senior technology advisor to client stakeholders while leading architects, developers, and technical specialists across CMS, analytics, DAM, personalization, experimentation, and AI-enabled capabilities. The role partners with Client Services, Technical Engagement Leads, Project Management, Analytics, and other technical teams to connect technical execution with measurable client outcomes.

What You’ll Do

Lead technical direction and delivery across client engagements, overseeing architecture, quality, scope, timelines, budgets, and resolution of complex platform and delivery issues.
Design, review, and approve architectures across Contentful, AEM, WordPress, Drupal, DAM platforms, analytics solutions, personalization tools, and associated integrations.
Define and implement digital measurement, personalization, experimentation, and DAM frameworks using tools such as Google Tag Manager, Adobe Launch, Google Analytics 4, Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target, Optimizely, Bynder, and AEM Assets.
Drive adoption of AI tooling, automation, coding assistants, and AI-enabled digital experience capabilities to improve delivery efficiency, platform functionality, and client outcomes.
Lead technical discovery, requirements definition, solution scoping, client presentations, and strategic recommendations while partnering with director-level and executive client stakeholders.

Qualifications

Required:

8+ years of progressive experience in marketing technology, software development, or digital platform delivery, including 3+ years leading technical teams, with responsibility for delivery, architecture, or people management.
Hands-on experience with enterprise CMS platforms including Contentful and AEM, with demonstrated delivery of production digital experiences and platform integrations.
Experience leading and mentoring technical teams across onshore and offshore delivery models, including workload distribution, capacity planning, performance management, and career development.
Experience designing and implementing enterprise digital measurement solutions using tag management, event-based tracking, data layers, consent-compliant analytics, and platforms such as Google Analytics 4 or Adobe Analytics.
Experience with enterprise DAM, personalization, and experimentation platforms, including metadata governance, workflow configuration, audience targeting, A/B or multivariate testing, and integrations with CMS, CDP, CRM, or marketing technology platforms.
Experience delivering client-facing technology programs in an agency or consulting environment using Agile/Scrum or comparable SDLC methodologies, including requirements, scope, technical recommendations, and executive-level communication.

Desired:

Comfort and enthusiasm for using AI as a regular part of how work gets done.
Experience supporting technology programs within pharmaceutical, biotech, healthcare, or life sciences agency environments.
Experience integrating AI-powered capabilities such as semantic search, content recommendations, generative personalization, or AI-enabled content workflows into production digital experience platforms.
Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or equivalent, with examples of improved engineering workflows or delivery efficiency.
Experience advising clients on platform-native AI capabilities across Contentful, AEM, Optimizely, or related MarTech platforms.
Experience contributing to business development through SOW development, technical proposal reviews, capability presentations, or client growth initiatives.

Additional Information

This posting is for an existing vacancy at Klick. The final amount offered will be determined based on several factors such as a candidate's work location, their unique skill set, education, and prior work experience.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

Klick is consciously creating a culture where everyone can thrive and grow in their careers. We believe that our best work comes from our diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We strongly encourage members of historically underrepresented communities to apply, including Black people, Indigenous peoples, and other people of color, people with disabilities, people from gender and sexually diverse communities and people with intersectional identities. We're also committed to developing an inclusive, barrier-free recruitment process and work environment. Should you require any accommodation, please contact us at careers@klick.com and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs and ensure you have a positive experience.

jobs.title: Staff Generative AI Engineer - Vice President
jobs.description:
We are seeking an exceptional Staff Generative AI Engineer to join our team. This is a critical, deeply hands-on role for a seasoned software engineer with a profound passion for Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and agentic frameworks. You will be instrumental in designing, building, and deploying real-world, commercial production systems, not just proofs-of-concept.

As a Staff Generative AI Engineer, you will:

Architect & Build Production Systems: Lead the hands-on development of sophisticated Generative AI applications, LLM-powered solutions, and intricate agentic frameworks primarily using Python. Your code will be clean, performant, scalable, and deployed directly into commercial production environments, solving real business problems.
Pioneer Automation with Agents: Design and implement intelligent agents capable of understanding, reasoning, and orchestrating complex workflows to automate critical enterprise business processes, driving efficiency and reducing operational risk at scale.
Master Containerized Deployments: Demonstrate deep comfort and expertise with container technologies, particularly deploying and managing applications within OpenShift environments.
Drive Technical Direction & Ownership: Contribute significantly to the technical strategy and roadmap for Generative AI adoption, influencing architectural decisions and technology choices across our product portfolio, ensuring all solutions are production-ready.
Champion Engineering Excellence: Instill and uphold rigorous software engineering best practices, including robust testing, code reviews, documentation, and continuous integration/delivery, ensuring the highest quality for our mission-critical systems running in production.
Innovate & Research: Stay at the bleeding edge of Generative AI, actively exploring new models, techniques, and frameworks.
Contribute to both applied engineering and research initiatives within the domain. You will have access to state-of-the-art AI- assisted development tools like Devin and Copilot to amplify your productivity and creativity.
Mentor & Collaborate: Act as a technical leader and mentor to junior engineers, fostering a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, product managers, and stakeholders to deliver impactful solutions.
Iterate & Deliver: Thrive in an agile, fast-paced environment, prioritizing rapid delivery, iterative development, and adaptability.
Focus on delivering measurable business value and learning quickly from prototypes and deployments, always with a path to production in mind.
Ensure Responsible AI: Design and implement robust guardrails and ethical considerations into AI solutions, proactively assessing and mitigating risks in line with organizational and regulatory standards.
Partner with multiple management teams to ensure appropriate integration of functions to meet goals as well as identify and define necessary system enhancements to deploy new products and process improvements
Resolve variety of high impact problems/projects through in-depth evaluation of complex business processes, system processes, and industry standards
Provide expertise in area and advanced knowledge of applications programming and ensure application design adheres to the overall architecture blueprint
Utilize advanced knowledge of system flow and develop standards for coding, testing, debugging, and implementation
Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating,
managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

Recommended Qualifications:

6+ years of professional software engineering experience, demonstrating a strong track record of designing, building, and delivering scalable enterprise-grade solutions in commercial production environments, not just proofs-of-concept.
Expert-level proficiency in Python is a must-have, with a deep understanding of its ecosystem for AI/ML development, data engineering, and backend services. Full-stack development experience is a distinct advantage.
Extensive hands-on experience with Generative AI concepts, Large Language Models (LLMs), transformer architectures, RAG, and advanced agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, Google ADK. Optionally AutoGen, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel).
Deep comfort and practical experience with containers and orchestration technologies, specifically OpenShift.
Demonstrated ability to architect, develop, and deploy highly performant, large-scale AI/ML systems into production
environments.
Strong understanding of modern software development principles, clean code practices, data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems.
Proficiency with Relational (preferably, PostgreSQL) and Vector (preferably, pgvector) databases.

Preferred Qualifications (Bonus Points):

Practical experience in model risk management, developing AI guardrails, and establishing end-user adoption pathways for Generative AI solutions.
A proven track record of contributing to open-source projects or publishing relevant research in AI/ML.

Education:

Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience

jobs.title: Director, Product Management, Enterprise Loyalty Consulting
jobs.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Director, Product Management, Enterprise Loyalty Consulting

Mastercard’s Services organization is a key growth engine, delivering innovative solutions that help our customers thrive. By integrating proprietary data, cutting-edge technology, expert insights, and strategic expertise, Services plays a critical role in driving Mastercard’s differentiation and business growth. The Consumer Acquisition & Engagement team is a key differentiator for Mastercard, providing the cutting-edge services that help our customers grow.

Mastercard is looking for a Director, Product Management, Enterprise Loyalty to drive growth of global Consumer Acquisition & Engagement (CA&E) consulting. In CA&E, we help clients build stronger and more profitable relationships with their customers through our combination of data, technology platforms, marketing capabilities, and expertise. Consulting plays a critical role in delivering outcomes for our clients through our trusted advisory that additionally draws in the right solutions from CA&E to solve our clients’ needs.

The Director, Product Management, Enterprise Loyalty Consulting will help shape the Enterprise Loyalty consulting vision. You will partner closely across Product, Marketing, Sales, Delivery, regional teams and external partners to build joint solutions, clear product narratives, strengthen go-to-market execution and ensure we deliver measurable value for clients, consumers and Mastercard.

What will you do?

Strategy: Help define the vision and product strategy for Enterprise Loyalty consulting
Product innovation: Oversee and evolve a portfolio of solutions that drives consumer engagement strategy and Enterprise Loyalty for many of the world’s leading Financial Institutions.
Go-to-market: Streamline our overall positioning and narrative to ensure our Enterprise Loyalty solutions are reaching clients effectively. Collaborate with product and sales to develop narratives that resonate in the market, and partner with our regional teams to build adoption and pipeline in local markets.
Client impact: Maintain a two-way dialogue with our consultants and sales teams to validate that we are delivering measurable client impact through the work we do.
Market Insights: Maintain awareness of competitive trends, emerging rewards models, partner ecosystems, and broader loyalty innovation across global markets
Product development: Support business case development, pricing inputs, packaging recommendations, and commercialization planning for new and enhanced consulting capabilities. Manage a product roadmap that balances short-term priorities with long-term aspirations.

What do you need to succeed?

Experience leading loyalty and rewards at an established financial institution
Visionary thinking and proven record of owning outcomes
Experience in a matrix organization structure, managing and building relationships with internal and external stakeholders effectively
Exceptional lateral (across stakeholders) and longitudinal (along different time horizons) thinking coupled with deep intellectual curiosity
Consultative mindset with the ability to craft compelling, customer-tailored narratives
Ability to break down and communicate complex ideas in dynamic situations
High level of ownership, quantitative acumen, creativity, and entrepreneurship
Deep knowledge in financial institutions, payments, and marketing

The range below reflects the full pay band for this position. The actual pay range for this role will be $150,000 - $200,000.

Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in Canada, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive pay based on location, experience and other qualifications for the role and may be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program. This posting reflects one or more current openings on our team.

Toronto, Canada: $150,000 - $234,000 CAD

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) will provide strategic and operational leadership for the technology function of CapitalSage Vantage, ensuring that technology, digital platforms, products, infrastructure, data and cybersecurity capabilities effectively support the Company's business strategy and growth objectives.

The CTO will lead the development and execution of the Company's technology strategy, oversee technology architecture and engineering, drive product innovation and digital transformation, and ensure the reliability, scalability, security and performance of all technology platforms.

The role will work closely with the GCEO/GMD, business and functional leaders to translate business requirements into scalable technology solutions, strengthen technology governance, optimise technology investments and build a high-performing technology organisation.

Key Responsibilities

1. Technology Strategy & Leadership

Develop and execute a technology strategy aligned with CapitalSage Vantage's business objectives, growth plans and product roadmap.
Provide strategic technology leadership and advise Executive Management and the Board on technology opportunities, risks and investments.
Establish technology priorities, architecture principles, standards and governance frameworks.
Assess emerging technologies and determine their relevance and potential business value.
Drive continuous technology innovation and digital transformation across the business.

2. Product Engineering & Digital Platforms

Provide leadership for the design, development, deployment and continuous improvement of digital products and technology platforms.
Ensure technology solutions are scalable, reliable, user-centric and commercially viable.
Oversee the product engineering lifecycle from requirements definition through development, testing, deployment and post-production support.
Establish effective software development methodologies, engineering standards, code quality practices and release management processes.
Ensure appropriate integration of internal systems, third-party platforms, APIs and technology partners.
Drive automation and technology-enabled improvements to customer and operational processes.

3. Technology Architecture & Infrastructure

Own the Company's technology architecture and ensure that systems are scalable, resilient, secure and fit for purpose.
Oversee cloud infrastructure, networks, databases, enterprise applications, systems integration and technology operations.
Ensure high availability, performance monitoring, disaster recovery and business continuity capabilities.
Review and optimise technology infrastructure to support business growth and increasing transaction/user volumes.
Develop and maintain appropriate technology standards and documentation.

4. Cybersecurity, Data Protection & Technology Risk

Provide executive oversight of cybersecurity and information security in collaboration with the appropriate risk, compliance and security functions.
Ensure technology platforms are designed and operated in accordance with applicable security, privacy and regulatory requirements.
Oversee vulnerability management, penetration testing, security monitoring and remediation of technology risks.
Establish and maintain effective access management, data security, backup and recovery controls.
Ensure appropriate data protection and privacy-by-design practices are incorporated into technology and product development.
Support regulatory examinations, audits and technology risk assessments as required.

5. Data, Analytics & Technology Intelligence

Establish a technology and data architecture that supports reliable business intelligence and data-driven decision-making.
Promote effective use of data across products, operations, customer experience, risk and commercial functions.
Ensure appropriate data governance, quality, availability and security.
Leverage analytics, artificial intelligence and automation where they can create measurable business value.

6. Technology Operations & Service Delivery

Ensure stable, reliable and efficient day-to-day technology operations.
Establish appropriate service management, incident management, problem management and change management processes.
Monitor technology performance against agreed service levels and business requirements.
Ensure timely resolution of critical technology incidents and minimise business disruption.
Develop appropriate technology disaster recovery and business continuity arrangements.

7. Technology Governance, Budget & Vendor Management

Develop and manage the technology budget, ensuring optimal allocation of technology resources and investments.
Establish governance processes for technology projects, architecture, procurement and implementation.
Evaluate and manage technology vendors, consultants and strategic technology partners.
Lead technology procurement and contract negotiations in collaboration with Procurement, Finance and other relevant functions.
Monitor technology costs and identify opportunities for efficiency and optimisation.
Ensure appropriate documentation, controls and accountability across the technology function.

8. Technology Projects & Transformation

Lead major technology transformation and implementation projects from conception through delivery.
Establish clear project objectives, milestones, budgets, risks and success measures.
Ensure technology projects deliver agreed business outcomes and value.
Work with business stakeholders to manage requirements, priorities, dependencies and change adoption.
Ensure appropriate testing, deployment and post-implementation reviews.

9. Team Leadership & Capability Development

Build, lead and develop a high-performing technology organisation comprising engineering, infrastructure, product technology, data and other relevant technology capabilities.
Establish appropriate organisational structures, roles, performance expectations and succession plans.
Develop technical leadership capabilities and promote continuous learning and innovation.
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, security, engineering excellence and customer focus.
Attract and retain high-calibre technology professionals.

10. Business Partnership & Innovation

Partner with Commercial, Product, Operations, Finance, Risk, Compliance, Customer Experience and other functions to identify technology-enabled opportunities.
Translate business challenges into practical and scalable technology solutions.
Support the development of new products, services, channels and revenue opportunities.
Continuously evaluate the customer journey and identify opportunities to improve digital experience through technology.
Represent CapitalSage Vantage in relevant technology, fintech and digital ecosystems.

11. Performance & Reporting

Establish and monitor appropriate technology performance metrics and service standards.
Provide regular reports to Executive Management on technology performance, projects, risks, costs, incidents and strategic initiatives.
Track technology investments against expected business outcomes.
Ensure technology priorities remain aligned with evolving business requirements.

Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline.
Master's degree or MBA is an advantage.
12–15 years of progressive experience in technology, with significant experience leading technology teams and enterprise-scale technology environments.
Demonstrated experience in a CTO, VP Engineering, Head of Technology, Director of Technology or comparable senior technology leadership role.
Strong experience in software engineering, digital platforms, cloud infrastructure, systems architecture and technology operations.
Experience within fintech, financial services, payments, digital financial products or technology-driven businesses is highly desirable.
Demonstrable experience taking digital products/platforms from development through deployment and scale.
Experience managing technology budgets, strategic vendors and complex technology projects.
Strong understanding of cybersecurity, information security, data protection and technology risk.
Experience working with APIs, system integrations, cloud technologies, databases and modern software development environments.
Relevant professional certifications in technology, cybersecurity, cloud, architecture or project management will be an advantage.

jobs.title: R&D Head – Agentic AI , Kitchener, Ontario
jobs.description:
Change the future with us.

We are looking for dedicated and talented people who solve ever-changing challenges, customer needs, and questions from colleagues with clever concepts and creativity. We embrace change and work with curious minds re-inventing the future of work. Join us and let us focus together on what’s truly important: making lives better with new ideas and the latest technology around the world.

About the role:
R&D Team Leader
- Agentic AI

Are you an entrepreneurial technology leader with a passion for building high-performing R&D teams and turning advanced AI concepts into scalable industrial platforms?

We are seeking an outstanding R&D Team Leader
to join Siemens Digital Industries Operations Software
, to lead an Agentic AI
team, based in Kitchener, Ontario – shipping real agent capabilities fast, while staying tightly aligned with the shared platform architecture and standards set across the program.

In this leadership role, you will lead and build the Canada’s Agentic AI team, and drive the development of secure, scalable, customer-ready platforms and shape the future of industrial AI.

Siemens Digital Industries Operations Software
is a suite of integrated digital solutions to engineer, simulate and operate manufacturing operations across industries. Operations Software includes our product portfolio in manufacturing engineering (COMOS, Tecnomatix, NX CAM, ...) & production operations (Win CC, Scada, PCS 7 / neo, Opcenter, Insights Hub, ...). The portfolio helps organizations across many different industries to improve operational efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance decision-making by providing real-time visibility and control across manufacturing and business processes.

Formula 1 cars, ships, mobile phones, space exploration vehicles, food & beverages, pharmaceuticals and many of the other objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and produced using our software.

We're redefining the industrial world using data and AI to make production: Agile, Adaptive, Autonomous. Eliminate productivity boundaries for today’s and tomorrow’s production operation. Join our mission to build the most comprehensive next generation AI-native Industrial Operations Software portfolio as the new operation system for industry in the age of AI. With us you have the chance to now apply AI to where it really matters: In the physical world of an industrial production and engineering of real things.

As part of Siemens Operations Software (OPS-SW), the Technology, Data Fabric & Agentic AI organization provides the technology foundation that enables the next generation of industrial software. Its portfolio includes AI Production & Engineering Systems, Data Fabric, Agentic AI frameworks, connectivity platforms, semantic data models, cloud-native architectures, and industrial AI services that power autonomous, scalable, and intelligent operations across the OPS-SW portfolio.

What will you do?

Collaborate across sites – work closely with the Global R&D Leader, Project Leads, and peer teams (Erlangen, Fürth, and beyond) to keep one coherent system, not disconnected experiments

What you will bring:

Deliver in fast environments – you're comfortable with ambiguity and rapid iteration, and you can create structure and predictability for your team where there is none
Build on shared foundations – you know how to align to a common platform and standards without letting your team become a bottleneck or a silo
Lead through technical credibility – engineers respect you because you understand the work and make trade-offs they trust
Balance innovation and pragmatism – you know when to try cutting-edge tools and when to pick boring, proven technology
Communicate across audiences – you can align your team, report up to leadership, and coordinate across distributed sites and time zones

What sets you apart:

Experience building agentic AI systems, multi-agent frameworks, or LLM-based orchestration platforms

Deep hands-on expertise in Python, distributed systems, cloud platforms, and modern AI/ML tooling
Experience with open-source AI frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, Nemo Platform, etc.) and a clear view of their strengths and limitations

jobs.title: Director, Security Architecture & Engineering, Information & Corporate Security
jobs.description:
Purpose. Performance. People.

Joining CPP Investments means joining one of the world’s most admired and respected institutional investors to drive a single mandate: to deliver strong, sustainable returns for generations of Canadians.

With a long-term horizon and global reach, we deploy capital at scale across public and private markets. Our size, stability, and disciplined investment philosophy allow us to pursue complex opportunities and build enduring partnerships worldwide.

For our people, this means meaningful work with tangible impact, real opportunity, and collaboration with exceptional colleagues who value partnership and performance. Here, you’ll contribute to outcomes that matter alongside team members committed to excellence and shared success.

The Role

The Director, Security Architecture & Engineering will provide strategic and technical leadership for CPP Investments' security architecture and engineering function. Reporting to the Managing Director, Security Architecture & Engineering, you will lead the development of enterprise security architecture, cloud security strategy, and security engineering capabilities while partnering across the organization to embed security into technology delivery and operations. You will build and mentor a high-performing team, drive innovation, and help strengthen CPP Investments' overall cybersecurity posture

The Team

Technology & Operations enables CPP Investments to deliver on its global investment mandate through secure, resilient, and innovative technology capabilities. The department partners across the organization to provide scalable platforms, modern infrastructure, and cybersecurity capabilities that protect the organization while supporting business growth.

The Security Architecture & Engineering team is responsible for establishing enterprise security architecture standards, advancing security engineering capabilities, and embedding security by design across technology platforms. The team works closely with technology and business partners to deliver secure, resilient solutions that effectively manage cyber risk.

Accountabilities

Provide strategic leadership, direction, and mentorship to the Security Architecture & Engineering team while helping shape and execute the organization's long-term cybersecurity strategy.
Lead the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of enterprise security architecture, ensuring alignment with business objectives, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
Develop and execute the organization's cloud security strategy, strengthening the security, scalability, and resilience of cloud environments.
Evaluate emerging cybersecurity technologies, trends, and standards, driving the adoption of innovative solutions that align with the organization's risk appetite.
Lead security architecture reviews and risk assessments, providing expert guidance and actionable recommendations to stakeholders.
Partner with technology, operations, and business teams to embed security-by-design principles throughout the technology lifecycle and effectively communicate security strategies and risks to diverse audiences.
Oversee the design and implementation of security platforms, automation capabilities, and engineering solutions that enhance operational effectiveness and strengthen the organization's security posture.

What You Bring

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related discipline.
CISSP, CISM, CCSP, or an equivalent industry certification.
Minimum of 15 years of experience in security architecture, security engineering, or a related cybersecurity discipline.
Minimum of 4 years of people leadership experience leading security architecture or security engineering teams.
Demonstrated expertise in enterprise security architecture, cloud security, security engineering, risk assessment, and security technologies within complex organizations; experience in Canadian financial services is considered an asset.
Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence technical and business audiences.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and collaboration skills, with a commitment to continuous learning and staying current with evolving cybersecurity trends.

You are motivated to contribute to something larger than yourself, approach complex challenges with rigor, and hold yourself to high standards in a collaborative, performance-driven environment.

We provide colleagues with cutting-edge AI tools, dedicated learning time, and practical support to help them deliver with greater impact.

Inclusion & Accessibility

CPP Investments is committed to equitable access to employment and building a workforce that reflects diverse talent and perspectives. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Attention: Protect Yourself from Fraud

CPP Investments is committed to a secure and transparent recruitment process. We will never ask candidates for payment or financial information at any stage of hiring. All legitimate opportunities are posted on our careers page, and communications will come from our applicant tracking system, Workday.

CPP Investments may use AI tools to help screen and assess applicants by analyzing resumes and applications for relevant skills and experience. These tools support, but do not replace, human decision-making.

jobs.title: Director AI Center of Excellence
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Director, AI Center of Excellence (CoE) is the technical and strategic leader of Future Electronics’ enterprise AI capability. This role sets AI strategy, builds and leads a team of AI specialists, and establishes the standards, tools, and governance that let AI and automation be adopted safely and effectively across the business.
This is fundamentally a hands-on AI leadership role. The ideal candidate has deep, current expertise in applied AI and automation and has personally built or led the delivery of real AI-powered solutions — not just directed others to. The Director works closely with AI Business Partners embedded in operational functions (Customer Service, Purchasing, Accounting, Finance, Marketing, and others) to turn business opportunities into working solutions, owning the technical direction, delivery standards, and team that make that possible.

Key Responsibilities

AI Strategy & Roadmap

Define and evolve the enterprise AI strategy and multi-year roadmap.
Evaluate emerging AI and automation technologies and assess their fit for the business.
Prioritize AI initiatives based on business value, feasibility, and risk.

Center of Excellence Leadership

Build, lead, and grow a team of AI specialists / automation engineers.
Set technical standards, delivery methodology, and reusable frameworks so solutions scale across functions instead of being rebuilt each time.
Coach and mentor the team, staying close enough to the technology to make real technical calls, not just review them.

Enabling the Embedded AI Business Partners

Act as the technical backbone for AI Business Partners embedded in operational teams — providing tools, playbooks, training, and hands-on support.
Translate business opportunities surfaced by embedded partners into scoped, deliverable AI/automation solutions.
Drive reuse and consistency across functions rather than each team building in isolation.

Governance & Responsible AI

Establish governance frameworks for AI development, deployment, and monitoring.
Ensure compliance with data privacy, cybersecurity, and regulatory requirements, in partnership with IT and Legal.
Promote responsible AI practices and manage associated risk.

Value Realization

Define KPIs and success metrics for CoE-led initiatives.
Track and report productivity gains, cost reductions, and business impact to executive leadership.
Build the business case for continued and future AI investment.

Qualifications

Required

Deep, demonstrated expertise in applied AI — generative AI, machine learning, or intelligent automation —
with a track record of building or leading the delivery of real AI/automation solutions. This is the single most important qualification for this role.
5+ years of hands-on experience in AI, automation, or applied data science, including recent, current experience with generative AI / LLM-based tools.
Experience leading or mentoring a technical team — as a people manager or as a senior technical lead.
Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical business stakeholders and executives.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred

Experience with enterprise AI/automation platforms (e.g., Azure AI Services, OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Power Automate, Microsoft Fabric, Logic Apps) or equivalents.
Experience in distribution, manufacturing, supply chain, or another global operations environment.
Experience establishing an AI or automation function from the ground up.

Leadership Competencies

AI & Technical Fluency

Stays current with the fast-moving AI landscape and can personally evaluate new tools and techniques.
Translates emerging AI capability into practical, scoped business solutions.

Strategic Thinking

Builds a roadmap that balances near-term wins with long-term capability building.
Connects AI investment to measurable business outcomes.

Team Building

Attracts, develops, and retains strong technical talent.
Creates a culture where engineers can move fast without losing rigor.

Communication & Influence

Builds credibility with both engineers and executives.
Makes the business case for AI investment clearly and convincingly.

Pragmatic Delivery

Biases toward shipping working solutions over long theoretical exercises.
Balances innovation with a relentless focus on business value.

Why join us

At Future Electronics, we mean it when we say we care about our employees. Our approach to employee wellness is holistic, which is why alongside competitive salaries, and premium health and dental benefits, corporate employees have access to:

● Onsite gym and fitness studio with scheduled group classes - think yoga, aerobics
● Telemedicine so you can get the care you need, when you need it, 24/7
● Group RRSP plan to take care of future you
● Onsite medical clinic
● Subsidized employee cafeteria with delicious meals and snacks.

Future Electronics is taking a hybrid approach to work. We value collaboration and working together, which our offices facilitate, combined with working remotely.
Future Electronics is an equal opportunity employer.
